name: Cometa
author: FranjeGueje
description: Show the achievements of GOG games run through Comet as Steam notifications.

settings.label: Active
settings.hint: Turns the web service on or off. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only: programs on this machine can send notifications, nothing else on the network can.

settings.label: Port
settings.hint: Where the service listens: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/cometa. Turn the service off to change it.

settings.label: Do not disturb
settings.hint: Requests are still received and answered, but nothing is shown on Steam. The test button still works.

settings.label: Comet — /cometa
settings.hint: Achievements sent by Comet itself (its custom_event setting). The usual method. Off: requests are answered, but nothing is shown.

settings.label: Comet, old method (by db) — /cometa/db
settings.hint: An alternative way to catch the same achievements, the old one: Comety reads Comet's database while a GOG game runs. Turn it on only if /cometa doesn't work: with both on, an achievement shows twice.
